I can't recommend this place enough! I took my dog in on Saturday, and the entire experience was wonderful from start to finish. The young woman at the front desk was so kind, friendly, and welcoming, which immediately put me at ease.

The staff was so understanding and compassionate. They gave her a flea bath for a very reasonable additional cost and even applied a flea treatment at no extra charge.

When I picked her up, she looked absolutely beautiful! The grooming was amazing, and you could tell they took great care of her. Their prices are very affordable, their customer service is exceptional, and they truly care about the pets they treat.

If you're looking for a trustworthy groomer, I highly recommend them. They are, without a doubt, the best in town!

Please do not take your dog here. I included before-and-after photos so people can judge for themselves.

I brought my dog in expecting a professional groom and left extremely disappointed. His tail was completely shaved down to almost nothing. When I asked why, I was told, "You never gave us any instruction on the tail." That response was shocking. A professional groomer should know that a poodle's tail is typically trimmed and shaped-not completely shaved off-unless the owner specifically requests it.

On top of that, they completely shaved the top of his head but somehow left long hair hanging around his eyes, which is one of the areas that should have been properly trimmed for both appearance and visibility. The cut is uneven and looks rushed, with no attention to the breed's natural look or basic grooming standards.

I trusted this business with my dog, and instead he came home looking nothing like he did when I dropped him off. Mistakes happen, but the lack of accountability was even more disappointing than the haircut itself. Instead of acknowledging the issue, they blamed me for not giving instructions that any experienced groomer should already understand.

I won't be returning, and I hope these before-and-after photos help other pet owners make an informed decision.

Don't go here if you truly love your pet!! I took my fur baby here for a bath & cut, it was my first and last time. Their prices may be low, but it's not worth it. That wasn't the problem, after returning home, I was petting her & keep feeling little bumps (at least 5 or more), which I then saw were scabs, then noticed one on each ear. I'm totally pissed thinking of how much pain my fur baby must have felt!! I no she must have yelped & now I'm wondering if they cut her nails to low & caused pain. Just because they put a bow on them and they look cute, doesn't mean they really care. I plan on finding out what I can do about it. We’ve been coming to this grooming shop for many years. While the service was sometimes inconsistent in the past, things became much worse after the new owners took over a few months ago. The quality of the grooming and bathing has declined noticeably. On our most recent visit my dog still seemed a bit dirty and was returned to me partially wet, which is unacceptable especially since we dropped my dog off at 10:00 a.m. as a walk-in. The owner told me it would take about two hours, yet my dog was not finished until 5:00 p.m. That is an extremely long time for a pet to be kept in a grooming facility. They appear to accept more dogs than they can reasonably handle, and it made me uncomfortable not knowing where the dogs are kept or whether there is enough space for them. If they are unable to take a dog, they should simply say so and ask customers to return another day.

We also had problems with our older dog, a 12-year-old Golden Retriever. After bringing her home from previous visits, she struggled to sit up and use her back legs, and it would take about a week for her strength to return. I cannot say exactly what happens there, but it left us very concerned.

We chose this place for years because it was close to our home, but we no longer feel confident in the care our pets receive. We have found another groomer and will not be returning.

I recently had a highly disappointing experience with Happy Paws Pet Grooming. I dropped off my father's dog for a full wash and cut, but upon returning to pick him up, I immediately noticed that the dog did not appear as expected. He did not respond to me in the usual manner, and upon closer inspection, I realized that the dog I had received was not my father’s. The dog had noticeable differences, including a crooked foot and lighter eyes.

At the time, I was with my 4-year-old daughter and had to return home quickly to tend to her needs, so I was unable to address the issue immediately. It wasn’t until later that I realized the mix-up. I promptly contacted the business, and the staff confirmed that an error had occurred. However, when I requested a refund or compensation for the mistake, the owner refused to take responsibility. The owner blamed us for not noticing the mix-up sooner and declined to offer any resolution, despite their staff admitting to the error. Additionally, the owner stated that no future grooming services would be provided free of charge, further exacerbating the situation.

What troubled me most was the lack of professionalism and accountability from the business owner. The owner also belittled her staff in front of me, blaming the cashier for the mistake even though the groomer had admitted to placing the dog in the wrong kennel. This behavior only added to the frustration, as it was clear the owner did not manage the situation effectively or take responsibility for the mistake. Furthermore, I was concerned about the potential liability implications, as there were significant risks involved if the wrong dog was not returned.

In addition, the quality of the grooming itself was subpar, further adding to my dissatisfaction. The situation was particularly stressful as both dogs were Maltese, making it difficult to distinguish them, and I didn’t even get a chance to see the dog face to face until after I dropped him off with my father, who immediately noticed the discrepancy.

I also felt sympathy for the cashier, Esmeralda, who was unfairly blamed for the incident. It was clear that the owner should have managed the situation better and provided a solution, but instead, she walked away from the situation and slammed the door when a resolution was not reached.

Given the lack of accountability, poor customer service, and unethical treatment of staff, I would strongly advise others to avoid this business. I have already filed a report in the hopes that no one else will experience a similar issue.
